issues.where: the haze over the whole flat and the far cliffs
issues.what: the air is far clearer than in -a; the cliffs read crisp and close, the far flats sharp, and the low steam banks that veil the middle distance in -a are thin or gone
issues.fix: bring back dense warm haze and low drifting steam across the flats and the cliff foot so distance falls off softly as in -a

issues.where: the pit and the rock bench on the right
issues.what: the pit is a clean dark hollow with tan, cut-looking banded ledges and little steam; in -a it is a pale grey collapsed limestone cavern filled with rising fume that veils the creature standing at its lip
issues.fix: make the pit rock pale grey and broken like -a and fill it with steam that rises past the standing creature

issues.where: the creatures on the far flats, left
issues.what: they are dark, sharply drawn silhouettes standing upright and widely spaced; in -a they are pale, small, softened by haze and many are bent down feeding in a long row
issues.fix: make them pale and haze-softened, smaller, more numerous, and mostly heads-down in a loose line across the water

issues.what: many separate bright red clumps scattered across the bench and foreground, including a large one at bottom right; -a has one main dark crimson mass behind the creature and a few small tufts
issues.fix: cut the clumps back to one main muted crimson mass behind the creature plus a few small tufts

issues.where: the foreground rock and the near water, left and bottom
issues.what: the near rock is chunky, dark-edged and plasticky with a smooth glassy pool; -a has low pale travertine shelves with thin film water glinting over them (see set-A-02)
issues.fix: lower and pale the near shelves and break the water into thin flowing sheets with many small glints

issues.where: the sky and sun, top left
issues.what: the sun area is blown out to a broad flat white glow and the steam plume is faint; -a has a defined low sun disc in a pink-amber sky with a strong lit plume
issues.fix: lower the sky exposure, keep a small sun disc and a strong backlit steam column

issues.where: the far creatures at x 4-21%, y 29-46%
issues.what: crop shows hard-edged, rib-lined dark bodies with sharp reflections; -a's are soft and pale in the haze
issues.fix: soften and lift them into the haze

issues.where: the background behind the three creatures
issues.what: the steam vents, low sun plume and the red growth on the lit rocks at right are gone; the cliff is a hazy snow-streaked wall instead of the dark ridge with a cave mouth, and the mid-ground is open flat water with distant standing creatures
issues.fix: restore the steam plume by the sun, the fume rising from the flats, the mossy rocks with red growth behind the right creature, and the dark close ridge

issues.where: the water around the legs (see set-A-04)
issues.what: the water is a calm smooth brown with soft ripples; -a has bright backlit splashes, droplets and rings of sparkle where legs and dripping heads meet the water
issues.fix: add splash, droplets and backlit sparkle at every leg and dripping head, with ring ripples spreading out

issues.what: they are darker, greyer-brown and leaner with knobby pink joints; in -a they are pale cream-pink with warm rim light from the sun and wet, stringy head fringes trailing long drips
issues.fix: lighten the hides to pale cream-pink, add warm back rim light and make the head fringes wetter and longer with heavy drips

issues.what: big dark wet boulders fill the bottom; -a has a soft out-of-focus low ledge with warm bokeh glints and a red tuft
issues.fix: replace with a low, defocused, warm-lit ledge with sparkle bokeh and a hint of red growth

issues.where: the sun and sky, top left
issues.what: the sun spreads into a wide washed-out white glare; -a has a tight sun disc in a deeper amber haze
issues.fix: tighten the sun and deepen the sky toward amber

issues.what: it is a dark open pit under one smooth tan arch with little fume; -a has pale grey bony rock ribs and slabs half-buried in thick rolling steam that spills over the edge
issues.fix: rebuild the pit as pale grey ribbed collapsed rock and fill it with dense steam that rolls over the lip

issues.what: the carcass is clean, smooth and pale tan with an even skin pattern and short legs; -a's is ragged with loose torn hide, bloody stains and a dark blood patch on the ground, long splayed legs with hooves
issues.fix: add torn sagging hide, red staining on the body and a dark blood stain under it, and lengthen the splayed legs

issues.where: the ground under the creatures (see set-A-06)
issues.what: the ground is wet, glossy rock with puddles and plasticky sheen; -a has dry, dusty pale gravel and crust
issues.fix: dry the ground into matte dusty crust with fine pebbles

issues.where: the red growth and the far shore, left
issues.what: the growth is dark brown-black grass-like fans; -a has bright crimson branching coral-like bushes, and -a's lit shoreline with feeding creatures beyond is lost in glare
issues.fix: make the growth crimson and branching and bring back the sunlit water with small creatures on the left

issues.what: the sun is a wide white wash and the far cliffs read as a snowy wall; -a has a sun disc in a pink-grey sky over a dark close ridge
issues.fix: tighten the sun, warm the sky to pink-grey, darken and close the ridge

issues.where: the carcass tail at x 29-46%, y 54-71%
issues.what: the tail is a smooth rubbery tube; -a shows a fibrous, ragged, stained surface
issues.fix: add fibrous texture and staining to the tail
